title: Tier 3 face verify: honest failure UX, audit reason, capture quality

requirements.expectation: isFacePass / readConfidence read face_data from top-level, data.face_data, or data.nin_data.face_data. Confidence values in (0,1] are treated as fractions and scaled to 0–100.
evidence: code: face-check.test.ts reads nested data.face_data / nin_data.face_data and scales fractional confidence (0.91 → 91).

requirements.expectation: Provider rejection results include a safe reason class: match_failed | capture_quality | low_confidence | provider_reject (plus existing NIN_REQUIRED / NOT_CONFIGURED / NETWORK paths).
requirements.verification: Unit tests classifying sample Prembly payloads and HTTP statuses.
evidence: code: face-check.test.ts covers match_failed, capture_quality, low_confidence, nin_required, not_configured, network on verifyFaceWithPrembly / classifyFaceFailure.

requirements.expectation: POST /api/liveness/verify on provider reject returns reason-specific user copy (NIN mismatch vs capture tip). Outage/not-configured paths stay 503. Audit pro.liveness.failed includes reason and confidence when present; never NIN or selfie bytes.
requirements.verification: Route tests with mocked face-check failures.
evidence: code: route.test.ts asserts NIN-mismatch copy + audit reason/confidence, capture tip for capture_quality, 503 for NOT_CONFIGURED/NETWORK; audit excludes NIN/selfie.

requirements.expectation: Selfie capture targets at least ~1280px width and JPEG quality ≥ 0.9; camera boot/retry request a higher ideal resolution than 640×480.
requirements.verification: Unit or source assertions on capture constants; boot/retry constraints.
evidence: code: capture-quality.test.ts asserts SELFIE_MAX_WIDTH≥1280, JPEG≥0.9, CAMERA_VIDEO_CONSTRAINTS; boot/retry import CAMERA_VIDEO_CONSTRAINTS.

requirements.expectation: A real Prembly nin_w_face call on the production/staging tenant succeeds or fails with a classified reason against a known-good selfie.
requirements.verification: Hosted smoke with Prembly wallet + camera.

code: Care UI for selfie / liveness_meta / failure class (tracked on liveness-server-authority).
external: Phase 0: diagnose a failing Pro via audit + Prembly when an id is available.
Confirm Prembly face endpoint/response on the tenant (open from liveness-server-authority).
